title: Miami Beach Art Deco Bike Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the best of Miami Beach on a 90 minutes guided bicycle tour, exploring its most iconic landmarks. Pedal through the vibrant Ocean Drive, admiring its world-famous Art Deco architecture and the historic Versace Mansion. Ride along the scenic paths of South Pointe Park with breathtaking views of the ocean and Miami skyline, and cruise past the luxurious yachts at the Miami Beach Marina. You'll also visit cultural landmarks like the Holocaust Memorial, while enjoying the lively energy and beauty of South Beach. This tour offers a perfect blend of history, culture, and stunning scenery, giving you an unforgettable Miami Beach experience.
